detail: Initial deliberately wrong-architecture mutant made the known-valid case raise the expected verifier exception, which unittest classified as an error. It was not counted as a semantic kill. Switched to the meaningful guard-bypass mutant and made positive tests explicitly assert known-valid acceptance; only the expected VerificationError is converted to that assertion. Unexpected exceptions, syntax and import errors still disqualify mutant detection. Added isolated command-budget, partial outer coverage and shadow-section mapping cases so weakened independent checks must fail assertions. Production source was not relaxed; final14 mutants compile and fail assertions without test errors.
